title: slow 90s R&B ballad
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I walked the city when the lights went down
Every window glowing like a golden crown
You were waiting where the river bends
Telling me the night would never end

[Chorus]
Hold me closer, don't let go
Take my hand and dance real slow
Hold me closer, don't let go
Stay with me until the morning glow

why: Registers are placed inside C3–C5 (a default C3–C5; add a voice profile for your real range), a semitone below your top note: verses low-middle, pre-choruses climbing, choruses up to about an octave above the tonic, a lift of 7 semitones over the verse peak.

mode: Minor: no mood words and no Artist DNA, so the most common R&B choice.
tempo: “slow” means 65–80 BPM; no Artist DNA, so the middle of the band.
key: G minor: verse and chorus peak fit your range with 2 semitone(s) to spare.
form: Section order follows the headers in your lyrics.
The last chorus is doubled to reach the length.
energy: Choruses sit 25 points above the verses; the final chorus peaks.
groove: Laid-back neo-soul pocket (sourced) from the R&B Atlas: pull (behind the beat).
atmosphere: Atmosphere palette: 90s R&B uses string-like pads and stacked-vocal textures in the hooks.
Each section's Atmos level (off / light / medium / full) sets how much texture it gets; the layers follow its chords and the energy curve.
arrangement: 90s R&B palette; roles per section follow energy and the Atlas “Texture and register lift” lift (vocal register up, background vocals enter, drum density up, stereo width up). Choruses bring in backing vocals, as your stem sets do.
